# ToolsKart — crawler rules
# Private/transactional pages stay out of the index.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /cart
Disallow: /checkout
Disallow: /my-orders
Disallow: /order-success
Disallow: /wishlist

# Sitemap is generated by the backend and proxied at /sitemap.xml
# (see next.config.js rewrite). Set your real domain after deploying.
Sitemap: https://www.example.com/sitemap.xml
